verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents its own integrations catalog of 'hundreds' and '100+' native integrations for automated evidence collection. Cloud-service connection, SSO-based app detection, and ticketing/Jira sync are each mentioned, but the evidence does not enumerate the stack categories or describe permission scopes. Missing for 10: documented coverage of HR, code hosting and MDM integrations, any evidence of read-only scopes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the catalog.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes

citations.quote: Secureframe seamlessly syncs with hundreds of the tools you're already using to automate evidence collection and continuous monitoring.
Automate manual evidence collection utilizing our 100+ integrations
Connect your cloud services to automatically check if you are configured for GDPR.
automatically detecting apps accessed by employees via SSO
follow-up tasks are created within the same workflow and can sync to your ticketing tools
